description: This file defines the Snapshotter class responsible for capturing and managing page frame snapshots within a browser context, including initialization, snapshot capturing, and frame hierarchy annotation.

classes.name: Snapshotter
classes.description: Manages page snapshotting, including starting, resetting, stopping, and capturing frame snapshots within a browser context.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Returns whether the snapshotter has been started.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the snapshotter, setting up necessary scripts and event listeners.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the snapshotter state in all frames.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Prepares the snapshotter for reuse by disposing of scripts and event listeners.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Sets up the initial script and event listeners for the snapshotter.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cleans up resources.

methods.name: _captureFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a specific frame.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures snapshots for all frames in a page and delegates the results.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Handles page events to annotate frame hierarchy.

methods.name: _annotateFrameHierarchy
methods.description: Annotates the frame hierarchy for snapshot purposes.
